name: Shimada (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Shimada city emblem in white: a stylised swirl of three curved bands.
history: Municipal flag of Shimada, a city in Shizuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 14 July 2005.

features.role: Shimada city emblem — a stylised swirl of three curved bands
